order: Close the probe/redraw cycle with a final ruling applied to the plan. Merge the two investigator classes into a single class — identical castings at every rung, a five-entry ledger, and the boundary treated as undecidable at intake — keeping the retired class name only as an alias; make no other class merges, holding the taxonomy at twenty-three classes. Add a new decision procedure: seven fixed-order steps where the first match decides, closing free entry into the later discriminator set. Amend three named discriminators and retire one. Reframe classification as a routing hypothesis, so safety rides on risk tier plus author family; restate the downstream gate as misroute recovery and rewrite the next work order to validate through the implemented router instead of a static reference set. Unblock the previously gated work order and close the outstanding pair ledger with its dispositions recorded.
claims: The two investigator classes were merged into one, holding the taxonomy at twenty-three classes with the retired name kept only as an alias; read-only-first ordering was internalized and the boundary treated as undecidable at intake. A new decision procedure of seven fixed-order steps was added, with three discriminators amended and one retired. Classification was reframed as a routing hypothesis tied to risk tier and author family, the downstream gate restated as misroute recovery, and the next order rewritten to validate through the router. The gated work order was unblocked and the outstanding pair ledger closed with dispositions recorded.
